title: The driver app's adoption record
description: Which shared-contract changes the driver app has caught up with. The driver app owns this file. The platform repo holds a report of it in 06-changes/adoption.json, never the truth.

checklist.task: Confirm every persisted field matches the frozen core shape

CHG-0001.note: The app already matches the frozen collection and field contract. The write-path audit on 2026-11-02 found every persisted field except trips.id to be exactly the core shape.

checklist.task: Read drivers.phoneMasked and show the mask on the confirm card
Remove the raw drivers.phone read and the client-side masking helper

CHG-0002.note: The Driver model carries phoneMasked; the server masks the value with the PHONE_MASK_FORMAT (98XXXXXX10) and the app never re-masks. Read-side only: the app never wrote the driver doc.

checklist.task: Call bindDeviceToVan({ driverCode, installId }) then signInWithCustomToken before any read
Call startShift({ driverId, date }) and sign in with the returned currentTripId token
Call endShift({ tripId })
Call markWardDone({ tripId, wardId, flagged })
Map the bind/start reason codes to localized copy

CHG-0003.note: Anonymous sign-in is gone with no fallback: a failed bind shows the server reason code. The app reads its scoped docs only after the bind. The trip create/ward mark/shift close client writes were deleted; the server owns them.

CHG-0004.note: The admin panel is the only affected app. The driver app never writes an admin-owned collection.

checklist.task: Write the GPS trail to trips/{id}/trail/{n}
Chunk at 1000 points per document with {points, from, to}
Stop writing trips.gpsTrail

CHG-0005.note: The tracking flush writes trailChunk documents through the repository; the legacy gpsTrail array write was removed from the app.

checklist.task: Delete the functions/ copy and functions/.env from the repo
Remove the functions block from firebase.json
Keep the cloud_functions CLIENT package for the CHG-0003 callables
Grep verifyDriverPin|setDriverPin|vanSecrets|DEMO_SEED_BYPASS across lib/ scripts/ pubspec.yaml returns zero hits

CHG-0006.note: The manifest's step 'Delete the cloud_functions dependency from pubspec.yaml' conflicts with CHG-0003: the app must call startShift/endShift/markWardDone. The client package stays; only the app's own backend copy was deleted.

CHG-0007.note: The arrival alert radius is a server-side constant. The driver app does not compute it and does not show the citizen's arrival screen.

checklist.task: Verify every Firebase config names safaaisaathi-63a87
Remove the driver-app-demo and test-project names

CHG-0008.note: firebase_options.dart and the bootstrap name the one project; no hardcoded fallback project id remains.

checklist.task: Delete the app's backend copy
Grep onCall|onWrite|onSchedule in lib/ returns zero hits

CHG-0009.note: The backend lives only at platform/04-functions. The app keeps only the callable clients.

checklist.task: Widen ComplaintStatus to the seven contract values

CHG-0010.note: pending_verification, auto_resolved and reopened join the original four. Stored data is not migrated: the original values stay valid.

checklist.task: Call markWardDone; the server writes wardDuty
Delete any direct wardDuty write from the app

CHG-0011.note: The app never writes wardDuty. The ward duty board is created server-side by the markWardDone callable.

CHG-0012.note: The driver app never held the raw complainant phone and does not read complaints.phone, assignedPhone or escalatedToPhone.

CHG-0013.note: The admin panel and the user app own the complaint write.

CHG-0014.note: The admin panel owns the data layer.

checklist.task: Confirm docs/PRD-2-driver-app.md matches the platform pointer

CHG-0015.note: The platform pointer already names docs/PRD-2-driver-app.md and the file is at that path. The hash is a platform-owner action, not the app's.

CHG-0016.note: The user app's stack is the question.

checklist.task: Declare trips.id in .contract/extensions/driverapp.json
Write trips.id on the trip round-trip shape

EXT-0001.note: The driver app's extension file declares trips.id, and the write path already writes it. Nothing in the app had to change to adopt this entry.

x-rules.noChecklistNoProgress: A change with no checklist shows 0 percent, not 100 percent.
x-rules.evidenceRequired: A status of adopted needs a merged pull request as its evidence. A field that needs no code change is adopted by the extension registration itself.
x-rules.notApplicableNeedsANote: A status of not_applicable must say why.
x-rules.oneFilePerApp: This file belongs to the driver app. The platform never writes it.
